proposal: CoNuExistentialism+ is a working philosophical/experiential family, NOT validated as a philosophy or claimed CoCivium canon. CoG_dSide+ and CoMetaAttractor+ retain the meanings in existing public source docs.
governance: Aliases, collisions, historical meanings and rights require independent review. No unearned theology, sentience, metaphysical causation or runtime authority. No claim human/animal subjective experience known from media.
selection: Prefer smallest useful cross-domain invariant plus falsifier, measured gain, term collision audit and human legibility.
